thread:
Leah (CSM): heads up — BrightFolio hit a usage cliff this week, DAU down ~32% vs last week. looks like onboarding stalled after their second integration task. tagging team for a quick winback plan :wave:
Matt (AM): saw the same in the dashboard. renewal is in 18 days, they're in an at-risk bracket and mentioned cost on the last call.
Leah (CSM): thinking a short 10-day recovery sprint, focused on stabilizing the core integration, unblocking devs, and putting a 30-day value snapshot in their hands before renewal. owners: Matt = pricing + offer, Jordan = KPI snapshot + charts, Eva = 15-min restart workshop + checklist.
Jordan (RevOps): I'll pull a delta report: missing events, last-7d retention, seat utilization heatmap. will drop CSV + internal link by EOD.
Eva (Enablement): I'll prep a 15-min "restart" workshop and a 1-pager with two remediation snippets and common logs to check. can run with their dev lead.
Leah (CSM): Matt — what credit/offer can we do on the standard plan? idea: 2 weeks of usage credit + 10% off month 1 if they attend workshop and hit two quick checkpoints.
Matt (AM): ok, conditional on workshop + 2 checkpoints within 10 days. I'll draft the offer email now.
Leah (CSM): timeline: Day 0 outreach + offer, Day 2 workshop, Day 4 apply quick fixes, Day 8 usage snapshot, Day 10 renewal prep deck.
CS Assist Bot: Reminder: BrightFolio (BF-9921) renewal in 18 days. Template: https://console.redwood.example/playbooks/recovery-sprint-template
Leah (CSM): Jordan — include baseline metrics we can show in the renewal slide: active workflows, avg tokens per run, error rate. want a conservative projected uplift if fixes apply.
Jordan (RevOps): Will attach baseline + projected uplift using conservative model and charts. CSV uploaded: https://dashboards.redwood.example/bf-9921/delta (internal).
Eva (Enablement): workshop agenda: 1) quick health check (5m) 2) config gaps (5m) 3) live fix on sample flow (5m). deliverables: 1-pager, checklist, two troubleshooting snippets.
Leah (CSM): add one-click feedback at end (NPS + short free-text). capture link to include in follow-up.
Matt (AM): draft email copy:
```
Subject: Quick 15-min restart + temporary credit for BrightFolio
Hi BrightFolio team — we noticed a drop in activity and want to help get you back to value quickly. Can we run a 15-min restart this week? If you join and complete two quick checkpoints we'll apply 2 weeks of credit and a promo on month 1.
—Matt
```
Leah (CSM): include acceptance criteria: workshop completed + two checkpoints in 10 days.
Jordan (RevOps): uploaded charts and a small dashboard snapshot.
Eva (Enablement): troubleshooting snippets I'll include:
```
# Reconnect: force-refresh token
curl -X POST "https://api.brightfolio.example/v1/refresh" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"

# Small batch replay
python replay_events.py --from-date=2026-03-01 --to-date=2026-03-10 --chunk-size=50
```
Leah (CSM): add a downgrade-mitigation note: if they must cut seats, propose a phased downgrade that preserves critical workflows (map workflows -> seats) and a quick export runbook. keep them on the platform even if they downsize.
Matt (AM): will add a "soft-downgrade" slide listing what to preserve and low-cost alternatives (rate-limits, quantization, reduced concurrency) to avoid seat cuts.
Leah (CSM): action list: 1) Matt send offer email today (owner Matt) 2) Jordan share KPI snapshot + slides (owner Jordan) 3) Eva schedule workshop + send 3 slots (owner Eva) 4) Leah prepare renewal prep doc with AE.
Jordan (RevOps): items ready by EOD.
Eva (Enablement): will send calendar options.
Matt (AM): email sent, cc Leah. :white_check_mark:
Leah (CSM): after the workshop we'll send the feedback form and tag this initiative as "recovery-sprint-2721" in Salesforce for tracking.
CS Assist Bot: Action logged: recovery-sprint-2721 created, owner Leah (CSM), linked to BF-9921.
Leah (CSM): will use this thread for quick updates only. ping here if anything changes. :spiral_calendar:
